provenance.generator: scratch one-shot mutation script (deleted after freeze); every fixture is a single documented mutation of the frozen golden gen/target.settled.json
provenance.construction: insertion-ordered objects serialized only with JSON.stringify; re-signing uses the public test-only filled-byte seeds 02/03/05 (golden keys are never live keys)
provenance.source: offline mutation of the frozen goldens; no gateway capture, import, live submit, or live-chain switch
provenance.purpose: frozen adversarial suite attacking the envelope parser and the transaction verifier; proves unknown or malformed authoritative fields fail closed before state promotion

role_rejection_detail: queried wallet is neither or both of the transaction's step_1/step_2 keys

vectors.name: invalid-utf8
vectors.defect: one byte of the golden head envelope is an invalid UTF-8 sequence
vectors.mutation: byte index 60 (the closing quote of the inner field name) replaced with 0xFF

vectors.name: duplicate-entries
vectors.defect: the data array carries the golden settled transaction twice

vectors.name: wrong-action-wrapper
vectors.defect: the wrapper field set deviates from the frozen get_transaction__v1 shape
vectors.mutation: wrapper key data renamed to result

vectors.name: wrong-action-data
vectors.defect: a valid wrapper carries a foreign action payload in data
vectors.mutation: data = {"available_balance":"10"} (a balance-query shape, not a settled-transaction array)

vectors.name: partial-entry-missing-step-2
vectors.defect: the settled entry omits the step_2_signature field

vectors.name: partial-entry-empty-step-2
vectors.defect: the settled entry carries an empty step_2_signature

vectors.name: unknown-inner-field
vectors.defect: the inner carries a field outside the closed 14-field shape
vectors.mutation: inner + extra_field:"x" (original signatures retained; rejection fires before any signature byte is read)

vectors.name: key-reorder
vectors.defect: the leading type field is moved to the last position, breaking the canonical insertion sequence
vectors.mutation: inner key insertion sequence rotated so type is last (original signatures retained; rejection fires before any signature byte is read)

vectors.name: whitespace-preimage
vectors.checklist_item: whitespace insertion in the inner preimage
vectors.defect: the inner preimage bytes carry inserted whitespace; validly re-signed over those exact bytes so the byte-exactness rule is the sole defect
vectors.mutation: inner serialized with JSON.stringify(inner, null, 1) and re-signed under seeds 02 (step 1) and 03 (step 2)

vectors.name: numeric-amount
vectors.defect: step_1_state.amount is a JSON number; amounts are string-only on the wire
vectors.mutation: step_1_state = {amount: 7.75} (a JSON number; rejection fires before any signature byte is read)

vectors.name: unpadded-key
vectors.defect: the step-1 wallet public key drops its trailing pad character
vectors.mutation: step_1_key_public__base64urlsafe = seed_02 key with the trailing = stripped (rejection fires before any signature byte is read)

vectors.name: malformed-key
vectors.defect: the step-1 wallet public key uses the standard base64 alphabet instead of base64url
vectors.mutation: step_1_key_public__base64urlsafe = seed_02 key with - replaced by + and _ replaced by / (rejection fires before any signature byte is read)

vectors.name: mutated-step-1-signature
vectors.defect: one in-alphabet character of the step-1 signature is flipped
vectors.mutation: step_1_signature leading character w replaced by x

vectors.name: mutated-step-2-signature
vectors.defect: one in-alphabet character of the step-2 signature is flipped
vectors.mutation: step_2_signature leading character u replaced by v

vectors.name: wrong-signer-key
vectors.defect: the seed-05 key is claimed as the step-1 signer while the golden seed-02 signature is attached

vectors.name: self-transfer
vectors.defect: both step keys are the same wallet; validly re-signed so both signature checks pass and only the role stage rejects
vectors.mutation: step_2_key_public__base64urlsafe = seed_02 key, re-signed under seed 02 for both steps

vectors.name: absent-wallet
vectors.defect: the queried wallet is neither the step-1 nor the step-2 key of the unmodified golden
vectors.mutation: none (baseline golden bytes); the queried seed-05 key is absent from both step positions
